behavior.explanation: No: an ordinary active space member may not remove a different member. DeleteSpaceMember first resolves the caller and target as active space memberships, compares their user IDs, and requires the caller to be a space administrator whenever the target is different. Self-removal is a distinct path: it bypasses that administrator check and invokes the store deletion as the caller. The visible store implementations additionally prevent removal of the last active administrator, including when that administrator is removing themselves. Thus cross-member removal conforms to the supplied administrator-only rule; self-removal is visibly permitted in principle but conditional on the last-admin safeguard and on unverified deployment/store selection.
